capabilities: pan and zoom the canvas to a linked node on click, in the same tab
copy internal links to canvas nodes from the node context menu or command palette
style canvas card link text with color, size, bold, italic and underline
render Markdown and math in canvas link display text
suppress note hover previews on canvas card links
extras: README is primarily in Chinese with an English summary. Verified only against Obsidian 1.13.7; the CSS rule that removes the node content blocker (to make links directly clickable) also makes card text selectable and embedded controls interactive, a documented trade-off. Installable via BRAT.
problem: In Obsidian Canvas, clicking an internal link inside a card opens the target in a new tab or leaves the current canvas, so cards cannot be wired up for in-canvas, presentation-style navigation.
summary: Canvas navigation plugin that turns internal links in canvas cards into PowerPoint-style hyperlinks that smoothly pan and zoom the viewport to the target node.
